articles.title: Pop Stars, Protests, and a Fiery Violin: Eurovision’s Wild Grand Final!
articles.summary: Imagine a singing contest where countries battle with wild costumes and catchy songs—and sometimes, politics crashes the party. This year’s Eurovision in Vienna had a Finnish flamethrower duet, a rapping protester, and five countries who stayed home to boycott Israel’s spot.

articles.title: Shakira’s Back with a World Cup Song—and This Time, She Brought a Friend!
articles.summary: Shakira, who gave us “Waka Waka,” has a new World Cup song called “Dai Dai” with Nigerian star Burna Boy. It mixes Latin pop and Afrobeats, shouts out soccer legends, and will help raise $100 million for kids’ education.

articles.title: Paul McCartney Crashes Will Ferrell’s SNL Monologue—and It’s Hilarious!
articles.summary: Will Ferrell hosted SNL, but his monologue got hijacked by a Beatle! Paul McCartney jumped on stage and joked that Ferrell is actually Red Hot Chili Peppers drummer Chad Smith. The real Chad Smith showed up too, and chaos erupted.
